title: Value of a negation gate
statement: Let $gs$ be a list of gates, let $i$ and $w$ be natural numbers, and let $x$ assign Boolean values to the inputs. Suppose $i<|gs|$, the gate at position $i$ is a negation gate reading vertex $w$, and $w<n+i$, where $n$ is the number of inputs. Then the value at vertex $n+i$ is the negation of the value at vertex $w$.
hypotheses_covered: The gate at position $i$ is a negation gate with sole input vertex $w$
$x$ assigns a Boolean value to each of the $n$ inputs
